description: vscode-jest 6.4.4 (T11.12, D125, B23e Phase 4): the all-tests request with coverage on (`--coverage` in place of `--no-coverage`, Runner.ts:103-105; the Test Explorer's coverage run sets `request.coverage`, test-item-data.ts:809), whose `coverageMap` vscode-jest reads from the results file (core.ts:856-868). The `text` table is on stdout. Istanbul's per-file `hash` holds the work directory's path, so it is masked by key, as the `coverage/*` fixtures do. Run with the editor's argv after the shell (fixtures/ide/README.md has the source lines). The editor's spawner sets no CI and no NO_COLOR and the recorder sets both, so `env` has "CI": "false" (ci-info reads that as not CI) and removes NO_COLOR; both are test choices, not the editor's. The output file is a relative path inside the project (vscode-jest uses a name under os.tmpdir()) and the reporter is the project's ./vscode-jest-reporter.js (the editor passes <ext>/out/reporter.js).
